scope: Landing page - CPF login form and accessibility controls
notes: Tested form submission with invalid CPF (12345678901), no accessible error message or aria-invalid. Tab navigation works. Accessibility buttons have visual state change but lack aria-pressed attribute to communicate state to AT. Console shows 1 error throughout session.

findings.observed: Button 'Alto Contraste' has icon with aria-hidden='true' and visible text 'Alto Contraste', changes visual appearance when clicked (becomes active state), but lacks aria-pressed attribute to indicate toggle state to assistive technologies
findings.expected: Button should have aria-pressed='true' or 'false' to communicate its current state (active/inactive) in accordance with WCAG 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
evidence: Button element found with textContent 'Alto Contraste'

findings.observed: Button 'VLibras' has icon with aria-hidden='true' and visible text 'VLibras', has visual indicator when clicked (VLibras widget appears), but lacks aria-pressed attribute to indicate toggle state to assistive technologies
findings.expected: Button should have aria-pressed='true' or 'false' to communicate its current state to assistive technologies in accordance with WCAG 4.1.2
